tytul: Tyndallized canned ham in jars: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for canned ham, a packed block of cured pork heated in jars several times (tyndallization).

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning.
NCHFP recommends canning low-acid foods, and tomatoes and tomato products, only according to the procedures in the USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning.
Tyndallization (repeated heating with pauses for spores to germinate) is not considered fully reliable, because some superdormant spores do not germinate between heatings.

akapity: Botulinum spores are very hard to destroy at boiling-water temperatures.
Red meats and poultry are low-acid foods.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for canning ham as a packed block in jars from a checked source.
